messages:
maya: heads-up — planning bring-up for ap-northeast1-newcluster on Wed 09:00 UTC. Need to lock 12x A100-40GB equivalents (or fallback A10G) for initial bootstrap + canary. Can procurement start quota/commitment now?
liam: on it. please post the exact quota request payload and cost center. will loop in quota-team.
maya: cost-center: infra-prod, internal-tag: rnwd-apne-new. preferred zone: ap-northeast1-a/b, prefer A100 if available, fallback: 16x A10G. target reservation window: Wed 09:00–Fri 18:00 UTC for bring-up and soak.
akiko: add network preflight: ensure private cluster egress rules to S3 endpoints and KMS control plane access. we'll need firewall: allow 10.5.0.0/16 -> GCP control plane IPs.
ton y: also request CPU and disk IO burst quotas for nodes — bootstrap runs concurrent model conversions and validators. estimate: 48 vCPUs, 2TB SSD IOPS burst.
procurement-bot: @liam created ticket PROQ-4312: "ap-northeast1 capacity commit request". Payload link: https://tickets.internal/PROQ-4312. ETA vendor response: ~24-48h.
liam: pinging quota-team for formal quota increase + reservation. @quota-team can you confirm process?
quota-team: quick checklist: 1) formal GCP quota request via console (project owner) 2) reservation request to vendor (region/sku) 3) attach commitment term (1 month) 4) confirm reservation ID and capacity token. We can draft the console payload here.
nate: draft gcloud request snippet I used last time:
```
gcloud compute regions reservations create rnwd-apne-res --region=asia-northeast1 --accelerator-type=nvidia-tesla-a100 --accelerator-count=12 --node-type=local-ssd --project=redwood-infra --description="bringup reservation"
```
Note: adjust accelerator-type for A10G.
maya: thanks. two asks: (1) can procurement negotiate a short-term commitment (7–14d) vs month to lower cost? (2) need reservation/commitment ID in ticket before Wed morning.
liam: vendor-gcp replied — availability limited in a-n1-a. They propose split reservation: 8x A100 in a-n1-a + 8x A10G in a-n1-b as fallback. Vendor estimate attached in ticket.
vendor-gcp: (automated) provisional reservation ID: VG-98231. Final confirmation after PO.
akiko: split is fine if we ensure scheduler placement constraints and model shard affinity. I'll add topology tolerations to the bootstrap helm charts.
ton y: put in plan for graceful fallback: if A100 < 12, scale canary to A10G variant, run perf smoke and latency SLO checks. Add metric: token_throughput and p99_latency.
sre-bot: scheduled health-check job created: "bringup-smoke" runs at 5m intervals for first 12h after nodes come up. logs -> /infra/logs/bringup-smoke.
liam: procurement asks for PO + finance code. @maya can you confirm finance approval?
maya: finance ok for ad-hoc bringup, approved under PO RNWD-2026-09. Please include cost cap of $9k/day in the ticket.
liam: updated PROQ-4312 with PO RNWD-2026-09 and cost cap. vendor asked for billing account and service account email for access.
ate: service account for vendor: vendor-access@redwood-infra. I'll rotate keys after handoff. Also ensure KMS grant needed to pull images.
akiko: pre-validate scripts to run once reservation allocated:
1) kubelet node bootstrap smoke: `curl -sS http://node-ip:10250/healthz`
2) docker image pull test: `docker pull us.gcr.io/redwood-infra/runtime:canary`
3) model load smoke (small model): run `python tools/load_model.py --model tiny --tokens 1024`
Run these in the staging VPC before shifting canary traffic.
ton y: also validate BFD and MTU across inter-pod networking; last bringup had packet fragmentation on cross-zone path. add `iperf3` test between nodes.
liam: vendor tentatively needs PO + invoice details. I'll attach invoice template to ticket.
procurement-bot: vendor asked to reserve capacity window: 2026-04-01T09:00Z -> 2026-04-07T18:00Z. Confirm or propose alt window.
maya: propose window: 2026-04-01T09:00Z -> 2026-04-05T23:59Z. shorter soak.
quota-team: to confirm: once GCP quota approved, we need reservation token + reservation name. Make sure to export reservation info to terraform state and tag with `env=apne-new` and `cost-center=infra-prod`.
liam: confirmed — will push terraform change in PR #4729. tagging included.
akiko: after reservation exists, who does handoff to oncall for monitor ops?
sre-bot: handoff checklist auto-created for oncall: pages for p99 > 1.5s, node OOMs > 2 in 10m, GPU memory errors. Assign to @tony for first 48h.
ton y: acknowledged. I'll be primary oncall for first 48h. add runbook pointer: /playbooks/bringup-apne1.md
maya: final items: (a) confirm reservation ID in ticket, (b) terraform PR merged, (c) smoke-green and canary at 10% traffic, (d) vendor access rotated after handoff. If all good I'll mark ready for Wed.
liam: will update throughout the day. ping me if vendor stalls. :thumbsup:
maya: thanks everyone, keeping this thread as single source for procurement + handoff notes.
